title: Aralo library manifest `aralo.yaml` (format v0)
description: The file at the root of a folder that marks it as an Aralo library. Unknown keys are accepted and written back unchanged. Format v0 is pre-release and may change without a migration.
$comment: Mirrors `Manifest` in crates/aralo-snippet/src/manifest.rs. When the two disagree, the Rust code wins; please report it.

format.description: The library format version. This schema describes version 0. A build refuses to open a library whose `format` is newer than it understands, so an old Aralo never rewrites a library it only half understands.

id.description: Names this library in the caches Aralo keeps outside the folder (index, vectors, merge bases). Aralo writes a ULID when it creates a library; this version accepts any string. Absent or null: no ID yet.

name.description: Display name of the library. Absent or null: none.
